name: print-social-orange-and-blue-grow-your-business-ad-with-seated-man
title: Orange and blue 'Grow Your Business!' ad with a cross-legged man on a laptop
whatItIs: A square ad split diagonally into orange and blue, a man in shirt and tie sitting cross-legged with a laptop, a white 'Grow Your' and blue outlined 'BUSINESS!' headline, a tilted 'Have an idea or project?' tag, Memphis dot patterns and a white wavy bottom edge.
whatItMeans: Bright and approachable; complementary colours and a relaxed pose feel upbeat.
techniques: Split the background diagonally in complementary colours.
Give the headline a stroked 3D effect.
Add a wavy edge to seat the cut-out.

vocabulary.definition: Hues opposite each other on the colour wheel.
Playful dots, zigzags and shapes from 1980s design.
